flora: Dense carpet of small herbaceous ferns (various heights, overlapping fronds)
No grass or broad deciduous leaves
Occasional fallen conifer needles (long, thin needles from Araucaria)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'softness' and density of the ground cover; tactile, plush appearance; no sharp dry elements; emphasis on a lush, moisture-rich environment.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle, wide-shot looking across a vast, unbroken carpet of ferns beneath the shade of larger trees (trunks visible but not the focus). The ferns should look like a soft, green sea stretching into the distance.
visual_logic.ground: Completely obscured by a dense layer of greenery; very soft and lush texture.
visual_logic.lighting: Cool, soft, and even light, as if under a thick canopy or a misty sky, emphasizing the deep greens of the foliage.
